$comment: Cross-tool shell-command permission registry — canonical path & format map for the permission-sync composer. Placeholders <user-home> must be expanded by consumers (redaction-portability). opencode is SSOT; the other four are SYNC targets.

claude.semantics: list of strings matched with fnmatchcase against full Bash(...) invocation; any match -> allow; default ask

copilot.semantics: list of /regex/flags strings; any re.search match -> allow; default ask

gemini.semantics: highest priority tier, first-match-wins; commandPrefix[] literal-startswith or commandRegex; decision allow|ask_user; default ask_user
